liz-marketing: Quick preflight: Targeting public announce for 'Dedicated + Optimize' tomorrow 9am PT. Need: final changelog entry, docs URL(s), and exact canary start time. @sam-eng @ashley-docs @matt-ops please confirm. Also any bench narrative lines to include?

sam-eng: On changelog — adding final bullets to repo now. I'll push PR and tag commit. Expect link in ~20m. @liz-marketing any special phrasing for the bullet?

liz-marketing: Keep it short: 'Reserved capacity with autoscaling + Optimize cost suggestions' — we can expand in blog. Also include latency/cost headline if we have numbers.

ashley-docs: Docs publish scheduled at 8:15am PT tomorrow. I'll share the draft link in a bit. Do we need a separate 'migrating from hosted' guide for Dedicated?

sam-eng: Tagged PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/432 — commit 9f1b2c3. Changelog excerpt below:
```
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, configurable autoscale policies
- Optimize: auto-batching suggestions + quantization profiles
- Console: per-route latency breakdowns
```

matt-ops: Canary/start: SRE recommends 8:30am PT start for internal canary (30m), public canary at 9:00am PT for 1 hour. If we hit error rate >1% roll back. @sre-oncall ok?

sre-oncall: Ack. I'll watch traces and token error rate. Pager on if >1% for 5m. Will post a status update to #incidents.

liz-marketing: Perfect. Ashley — once docs live can you paste both stable and staging links here? We need stable for press + staging for support.

ashley-docs: Links:
staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/dedicated-optimize
stable: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated-optimize
Also uploaded hero screenshots to the assets bucket: gs://redwood-assets/launch/dedicated-optimize/

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: changelog PR merged at 5378901400, docs publish started at 5378901700, canary rollout initiated at 5378902600.

liz-marketing: :thumbsup: I'll queue the launch post and webinar invite. Need final benchmark headline by EOD today. Thanks team.
